I have prepared a few slides about RGSOC that I plan to present for the R meeting in Quebec City later this month http://raquebec.ulaval.ca/2017/event/le-projet-r-dans-google-summer-of-code (French language web site)

The slides are in English and the source code is here https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/blob/master/HOCKING-RGSOC.tex -- if anybody wants to copy or adapt these slides to talk about GSOC, feel free.
